note: Independent re-judgment at HEAD against RFC 6811 Section 4 ('When a mapping is added or deleted, the implementation MUST re-validate any affected prefixes and run the BGP decision process if needed.'). Verified producers (rpki/rpki.go::handleROAChange, adj_rib_in/rib_validation.go::applyToInstalled) and all 4 tagged test files (6 tags): TestHandleROAChangeReValidates tests only rp.cache.Add and unchanged-cache negative; TestReValidationAppliesToInstalledRoutes tests direct ValidationDecision rewrites and unknown-prefix buffering; test/plugin/rpki-revalidate-late-sync.ci tests VRP addition into adj-rib-in only; test/plugin/rpki-revalidate-selected-route.ci tests VRP addition removing an Invalid route from BGP best/Loc-RIB while keeping a Valid control selected (and explicitly notes mapping deletion is unproven). Q4 fails: no tagged test exercises mapping DELETION (removing a VRP and verifying re-validation and BGP decision process re-run for affected prefixes), so the requirement remains weak.
